{{Quote|J-type 327 Nubian royal starship. Handcrafted, very few made, unarmed, used to transport the Queen of Naboo and her retinue.|[[Roggo]]|<ref name="Darth Vader 21" />}}
The '''J-type 327 Nubian royal starship''' was a [[starship]] model designed and built by [[Nubia Star Drives, Incorporated|Nubia Star Drives, Inc.]]. They used a [[sublight engine]] and a [[T-14 hyperdrive generator]], also designed by Nubian Design Collective. The T-14 [[hyperdrive]] gave the J-type 327 Nubian a hyperdrive rating of 1.8.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" />

The [[Naboo Royal Starship]] used by [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] was technically a modified J-type 327 Nubian starship, due to the unique spaceframe being built around an imported Nubian sublight engine and T-14 hyperdrive. It therefore had to use J-type 327 Nubian parts.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /><ref name="Episode I" /> During the [[Invasion of Naboo]] it transported Amidala, [[Jedi]] [[Jedi Master|Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. In the [[Imperial Era|era]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] came to own Amidala's starship after being given it by his [[Sith Master]] [[Darth Sidious]].<ref name="Darth Vader 20">[[Darth Vader (2017) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 20]]</ref> Vader took it to [[Mustafar]] and deactivated the shields for atmospheric entry, scorching the body of the vessel. He then used it as a base of operations while creating [[Fortress Vader|his castle]] there.<ref name="Darth Vader 21">[[Darth Vader (2017) 21|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 21]]</ref> The ship's hull was later returned to its pristine condition.<ref name="Darth Vader 4" />
